compatibility_amendment.precedence: Overrides legacy-only compatibility requirements in historical task acceptance and discovery inventories; preserves current behavior/authentication/deterministic replay.
compatibility_amendment.retirement: Exact-ID retired_compatibility disposition requires named legacy-only guarantee and owner decision, no replacement proof; mixed rows retain noncompatibility terms.

counts_interpretation: Historical discovery and ownership counts; retained acceptance excludes explicitly retired_compatibility rows.

disposition_contract.keep: At least one named EXISTING catching test or mutation. This is not exhaustive conjunct/field coverage.
disposition_contract.pending_regression: Retained current behavior/integrity/bound guarantee awaiting catching proof. A solely legacy-compatibility guarantee may instead be explicitly retired under the owner amendment.
disposition_contract.delete: Delete/fold redundant checks only with retained guarantee coverage; compatibility-only rows may retire without replacement under the owner amendment.
disposition_contract.retired_compatibility: Exact original ID with named waived legacy-only guarantee and owner-policy reference. No replacement implementation/catching test; not an execution pass.

cutover_gate: Every retained endpoint has an executable current Rust route and catching proof; zero unresolved retained guarantees. Explicitly retired compatibility-only rows/endpoints need dispositions, not replacement code/proof. Original source expressions and IDs remain discovery history.
row_disposition_owner: Batch proof maps identify exact compatibility-only retirements; conductor merges their accepted dispositions before cutover. Empty list makes no retirement or pass claim.
